request.request: Write the paragraph from the officer's details in document 1.

response_text: {"paragraph":"The Environmental Student Assembly is putting together the Earth Week Fair, and we would love for you to join us as a co-host. The fair brings together tables from campus sustainability groups, a clothing swap and a set of talks, and it is open to USC students who want to learn more about sustainability and take part in hands-on ways. As a fellow recognized student organization, you would share in hosting the event with us and help run two of the tables. Your involvement would help make the fair feel welcoming and well run for the students who come, and it would give them more people to talk with and learn from. We would be glad to hear your thoughts and plan it together.","contains_instructions":false}
